scope: recorded MAPPO Blender scene with native cosmetic repair and new 0.6m x 0.015m appearance-only line; no field data
heldout: separate inspection view at each fit time, never in input bundle
input_gate: line projected width >=2px and absolute local grayscale contrast >=10/255
quality_gate: core coverage >=0.9, contrast retention >=0.5, location/boundary <=0.1m; all require identifiable material correspondence
source_geometry: evaluation only; masks from RGB brightness and exterior contour fill
